title: 38M → 19M
subtitle: Poland, in millions; UN projection after 2023

lines.say: On the United Nations' central projection, it shrinks decade after decade.
Very low birth rates, about 1.3 children per woman. Few immigrants. And many young Poles working abroad.
A big challenge for one of Europe's fastest-growing economies. Where it sits among Europe's biggest populations, in our full video.
